title: Padachone Ingalu Kaatholee
overview: Dineshan, Grace, Giri, KK and Gund Saji are involved in leftwing politics. Dineshan gets attracted to a girl who stays over at his house and she makes him consider all the occurrences that happen at home and take action for them.

songs.title: Enth Paangh... Enth Paangh
songs.singers: Shaan Rahman, Ramya Nambessan, KS Harisankar
